youtube.title: Vikings never wore horned helmets. Except this guy 🐮 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Did Vikings wear horned helmets? Nope. Not one. 🐮

Except Bjorn. Bjorn has a vision.

Comment the reply YOU would've sent Bjorn 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: no Viking-age helmet with horns has ever been found (the Gjermundbu helmet is a plain iron cap). The horned look comes from 19th-century art and the costumes of Wagner's 1876 Ring opera.

#vikings #vikinghistory #vikinghelmet #historymyths #historyfacts #historymemes #shorts
